Authentication

All API requests require your secret API key passed in the X-API-Key header. You can generate keys inside your developer dashboard.

X-API-Key: sm_live_your_api_key_here

Base URL

Submit all API payloads to the following root address:

https://api.startmessaging.com

snippets.code:
package main

import (
  "bytes"
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "io"
)

func main() {
  payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
    "requestId": "req_abc123",
    "otpCode":   "123456",
  })

  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.startmessaging.com/otp/verify", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  req.Header.Set("X-API-Key", "sm_live_your_api_key_here")

  resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  defer resp.Body.Close()

  body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(string(body))
}

body.en:
Response Formats

The Send OTP response returns confirmation status and unique identifiers:

{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "requestId": "req_abc123",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-15T10:30:00.000Z",
  "data": {
    "otpRequestId": "uuid-of-otp-request",
    "messageId": "uuid-of-message",
    "status": "queued"
  }
}

The Verification response returns boolean confirmation value:

{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestId": "req_xyz789",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-15T10:31:00.000Z",
  "data": {
    "verified": true
  }
}

question.en: What verification methods does the Auth API support?
question.ar: ما هي طرق التحقق التي تدعمها واجهة Auth؟

answer.en: For now the Auth API is SMS-only. It supports: 1) OTP delivery via transactional SMS, 2) OTP code verification, 3) Phone number format validation, and 4) Carrier/reachability lookup — all through a single API. More channels are planned.
answer.pt: Por enquanto, a API de Auth funciona apenas com SMS. Ela oferece: 1) envio de OTP por SMS transacional, 2) verificação do código OTP, 3) validação do formato do número de telefone e 4) consulta de operadora/alcançabilidade — tudo em uma única API. Mais canais estão planejados.
answer.es: Por ahora, la API de Auth funciona solo con SMS. Ofrece: 1) envío de OTP por SMS transaccional, 2) verificación del código OTP, 3) validación del formato del número de teléfono y 4) consulta de operador/alcanzabilidad — todo en una única API. Hay más canales planificados.
answer.id: Untuk saat ini API Auth hanya mendukung SMS. Fiturnya: 1) pengiriman OTP via SMS transaksional, 2) verifikasi kode OTP, 3) validasi format nomor telepon, dan 4) pencarian operator/keterjangkauan — semuanya melalui satu API. Lebih banyak kanal sedang direncanakan.
answer.ar: تعمل واجهة Auth حالياً عبر SMS فقط. وهي تدعم: 1) إرسال OTP عبر SMS المعاملاتية، 2) التحقق من رمز OTP، 3) التحقق من تنسيق رقم الهاتف، و4) فحص شركة الاتصالات/إمكانية الوصول — كل ذلك عبر واجهة API واحدة. المزيد من القنوات مخطط لها.
answer.tr: Auth API şimdilik yalnızca SMS destekliyor. Sunduğu özellikler: 1) işlemsel SMS ile OTP gönderimi, 2) OTP kodu doğrulama, 3) telefon numarası biçim doğrulaması ve 4) operatör/erişilebilirlik sorgusu — hepsi tek bir API üzerinden. Daha fazla kanal planlanıyor.
